blocks.html: Mahakaar 3XL1 is nn industrial large-format Fused Granular Fabrication (FGF) pellet extrusion 3D printer engineered for high-speed manufacturing of oversized components, tooling, molds, prototypes, and functional industrial parts. Built for industrial production environments, research centers, innovation labs, and advanced manufacturing facilities, the Mahakaar 3XL1 combines large build capacity, pellet-based material extrusion, and industrial motion systems to deliver fast, cost-effective additive manufacturing at scale.

Key Features

Massive Build Volume

Large-format build capacity enables production of oversized industrial components and full-scale prototypes.

Pellet Extrusion Technology

Direct pellet extrusion significantly reduces material costs compared to filament-based systems while supporting high material throughput.

High-Speed Industrial Printing

Industrial servo-driven motion systems and screw extrusion architecture enable rapid manufacturing of large components.

Industrial Screw Extrusion System

Advanced screw extrusion mechanism provides stable material flow, consistent extrusion, and high-efficiency printing.

High Material Throughput

Supports extrusion rates up to 8 kg/h for fast large-format production.

Wide Material Compatibility

Compatible with a broad range of thermoplastic pellet materials including engineering-grade polymers.

Industrial Motion System

Servo motor-driven architecture combined with precision transmission systems ensures stable and accurate movement.

Heavy-Duty Steel Construction

Industrial welded steel frame designed for rigidity, reliability, and long-term operational stability.

Automatic Feeding System

Integrated automatic feeding and vibration-assisted material handling system for uninterrupted printing.
